input.prompt: Generate ONE original 16:9 painted fantasy image. Create ONE equal 3-column by 2-row sheet of SIX distinct painterly wide story-card vignettes, clear narrow dark gutters, no frame or lettering. Row 1: hands sharing a loaf beside a bowl; a single empty bowl on an empty communal bench; guard boots passing an iron grille. Row 2: a quiet old fracture between two ward stones; anonymous hands exchanging a small plain token beneath an awning; the empty arena glimpsed through iron bars. Focus on objects, no identifiable cast faces. Reference-1.png is visual guidance only. Covenant family: rich hand-painted volumes, worn stone, oxidized metal, pale layered cloth, restrained edge ornament and broad quiet surfaces. No paper or book texture, no all-over grain, no photographs or 3D render. NO words, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, interface or diagrams. No active magic in the guarded camp. Original design only.
